intro.introText1: In Taitung, "slow" is not just a pace, but a choice—a choice to coexist with nature and embrace a life philosophy in tune with the land.
intro.introText2: 2026 Taitung Expo takes "slow economy" as its curatorial core and "Taitung blue" as its visual language, blending Austronesian cultural spirit with a vision for sustainable development to chart future mountain paths and sea routes from Taitung to the world.
intro.introText3: We invite everyone who steps into Taitung to slow down, savor the tranquility and abundance of this land, and reconnect with a simpler rhythm of life.
